title: Asking About Rent
situation: A tenant asks a landlord about monthly rent and the deposit.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa mulkiile weydiinaya kirada bisha iyo lacagta dhigaalka.
key_phrases: The deposit is one month's rent.
I am interested in renting it.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: How much is the rent?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: The rent is six hundred dollars a month.
dialogue.somali: Kiradu waa lix boqol oo doolar bishii.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Is the room available?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: The room is available now.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Is there a deposit?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: The deposit is one month's rent.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I am interested in renting it.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: You can see it this afternoon.

title: Viewing a Small House
situation: A buyer views a small house and asks about the price and neighborhood.
somali_situation: Iibsade ayaa daawanaya guri yar wuxuuna weydiinayaa qiimaha iyo xaafadda.
key_phrases: I am thinking about buying a house.

dialogue.speaker: Buyer
dialogue.english: I am thinking about buying a house.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan ka fikirayaa inaan guri iibsado.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: This house is small but comfortable.
dialogue.somali: Gurigani waa yar yahay laakiin raaxo leh.

dialogue.speaker: Buyer
dialogue.english: What is the price?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: The price is listed on the sheet.
dialogue.somali: Qiimuhu wuxuu ku qoran yahay warqadda.

dialogue.speaker: Buyer
dialogue.english: How many bedrooms are there?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: There are two bedrooms and a small garden.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa jira laba qol jiif iyo beer yar.

dialogue.speaker: Buyer
dialogue.english: Is the neighborhood noisy?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: The neighborhood is quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Buyer
dialogue.english: Can I make an offer?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.english: Yes, I can send your offer today.
dialogue.somali: Haa, maanta ayaan dalabkaaga diri karaa.

title: Buying Furniture for an Apartment
somali_title: Alaab guri oo dabaq loo iibsanayo
situation: A tenant chooses basic furniture for a small apartment and checks delivery.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa dooranaya alaab guri oo aasaasi ah dabaq yar wuxuuna hubinayaa keenista.
key_phrases: I need furniture for a small apartment.
This bed will fit the room.
I will take the table and two chairs.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I need furniture for a small apartment.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay alaab guri oo dabaq yar ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Let us start with the sofa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: The sofa is too wide.
dialogue.somali: Fadhigu aad buu u ballaaran yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: This smaller sofa may work.
dialogue.somali: Fadhigan ka yar wuu shaqayn karaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: What about the bed?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: This bed will fit the room.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I also need a table.
dialogue.somali: Sidoo kale waxaan u baahanahay miis.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: This table comes with two chairs.
dialogue.somali: Miiskani wuxuu la socdaa laba kursi.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Can you include delivery?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, delivery is tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I will take the table and two chairs.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan qaadanayaa miiska iyo laba kursi.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Great. I will add them to the order.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Dalabka ayaan ku dari doonaa.

title: Checking a Shared Kitchen
somali_title: Jiko la wadaago oo la hubinayo
situation: A new tenant asks how to use a shared kitchen and where to keep food.
somali_situation: Kirayste cusub ayaa weydiinaya sida loo isticmaalo jiko la wadaago iyo meesha cuntada lagu keydiyo.
key_phrases: How does the shared kitchen work?
Use the top shelf in the fridge.
Please clean the stove after cooking.
The cupboard beside the sink is empty.
We label food to avoid confusion.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: How does the shared kitchen work?
dialogue.somali: Jikada la wadaago sidee bay u shaqaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Everyone cleans their own dishes.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: Where can I put my food?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Use the top shelf in the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: Is there space for rice and tea?
dialogue.somali: Meel bariis iyo shaah ma jirtaa?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: The cupboard beside the sink is empty.
dialogue.somali: Kabadhka saxanka agtiisa wuu bannaan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: Can I use the stove tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Yes, but please clean the stove after cooking.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin fadlan shooladda nadiifi karinta ka dib.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: Should I wash pans right away?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Yes, the sink gets crowded after dinner.
dialogue.somali: Haa, saxanku cashada ka dib wuu buuxsamaa.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: How do people know which food is mine?
dialogue.somali: Dadku sidee bay ku ogaadaan cuntada aniga ii taal?

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: We label food to avoid confusion.
dialogue.somali: Cuntada magac ayaan ku qornaa si wareer looga fogaado.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: That is fair.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: If something is shared, we write shared on it.
dialogue.somali: Haddii wax la wadaago, waxaan ku qornaa la wadaago.

dialogue.speaker: New Tenant
dialogue.english: Thanks. I will label my things tonight.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Caawa ayaan alaabtayda magac ku qori doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Housemate
dialogue.english: Great. Welcome to the house.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Ku soo dhowow guriga.

title: Asking About the Bathroom
situation: A guest asks where the bathroom is and whether there is soap and a towel.
somali_situation: Marti ayaa weydiinaya meesha musqushu ku taal iyo haddii saabuun iyo tuwaal jiraan.
key_phrases: There is soap by the sink.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Where is the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: It is behind that door.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Is there soap?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: There is soap by the sink.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Do you need a towel?

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: Yes, a clean towel is on the shelf.
dialogue.somali: Haa, tuwaal nadiif ah ayaa shelf-ka saaran.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.english: Thank you, I found it.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.english: You are welcome, guest.

title: Reporting a Leaking Tap
somali_title: Qasab biyo daadinaya oo la sheegayo
situation: A tenant reports a leaking tap and arranges a repair visit.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa sheegaya qasab biyo daadinaya wuxuuna qabanayaa booqasho dayactir.
key_phrases: I need a repair in the kitchen.
Thank you for arranging the repairs.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I need a repair in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: What is broken?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: The tap has a leak.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Is there a lot of water?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Water is dripping slowly.
dialogue.somali: Biyaha si tartiib ah bay u dhibcayaan.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: I will call a plumber.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Can a plumber come tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Yes, tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Thank you for arranging the repairs.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad dayactirrada qabanqaabisay.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Please keep a bowl under the tap tonight.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan caawa baaquli dhig qasabku hoostiisa.

title: Asking About Utilities
situation: A tenant asks which utilities are included in the rent and how to pay the electricity bill.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa weydiinaya adeegyada guriga ee kirada ku jira iyo sida loo bixiyo biilka korontada.
key_phrases: Are utilities included in the rent?
The internet password is on the fridge.
How do I pay the bill?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Are utilities included in the rent?
dialogue.somali: Adeegyada gurigu kirada ma ku jiraan?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Water is included.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: What about electricity?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Electricity is a separate bill.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: How do I pay the bill?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: You can pay online each month.
dialogue.somali: Bil kasta internetka ayaad ku bixin kartaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Is internet included?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Yes, the internet password is on the fridge.
dialogue.somali: Haa, erayga sirta ah ee internetku wuxuu ku yaal qaboojiyaha.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: That helps. I work from home.
dialogue.somali: Taasi way caawinaysaa. Guriga ayaan ka shaqeeyaa.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: The connection is usually strong.
dialogue.somali: Xiriirku badanaa wuu xoog badan yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Please send me the payment link.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ii soo dir linkiga lacag-bixinta.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: I will send it today.

title: Planning Moving Day
situation: A tenant and mover plan moving day, discuss boxes, stairs, and arrival time.
somali_situation: Kirayste iyo rare ayaa qorsheynaya maalinta guuritaanka, waxay ka hadlayaan sanduuqyo, jaranjaro, iyo waqtiga imaatinka.
key_phrases: We are moving on Saturday morning.
How many boxes do you have?
The elevator is too small for the sofa.
The truck arrival time is eight.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: We are moving on Saturday morning.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: The truck arrival time is eight.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: That is early, but it works.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hore, laakiin way shaqaynaysaa.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: How many boxes do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: About twenty boxes.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: Please mark the fragile boxes.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I marked the dishes and glasses.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: Is there an elevator?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Yes, but the elevator is too small for the sofa.
dialogue.somali: Haa, laakiin wiishku fadhiga aad buu ugu yar yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: Then we will use the stairs for the sofa.
dialogue.somali: Markaa fadhiga jaranjarada ayaan marin doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Will that take much longer?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waqti badan ma qaadan doontaa?

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: Only a little longer.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Please call before you arrive.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan wac ka hor intaadan imaan.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: I will call from the street.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Good. I will be ready.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Diyaar ayaan ahaan doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Mover
dialogue.english: See you Saturday.

title: Meeting a New Neighbor
situation: A tenant greets a new neighbor and asks about quiet hours.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa salaamaya deris cusub wuxuuna weydiinayaa saacadaha aamusnaanta.
key_phrases: Hello, I am your new neighbor.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Hello, I am your new neighbor.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.english: Welcome to the building.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Is it quiet at night?

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.english: Yes, it is usually quiet.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Good. I work early.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Hore ayaan shaqada u bilaabaa.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.english: Please close the door softly.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan albaabka si tartiib ah u xir.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Of course. The neighbours are friendly.

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.english: We try to help each other.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan isku daynaa inaan is caawinno.

title: Checking Home Safety
situation: A tenant asks about locks, smoke alarms, and emergency contact details.
somali_situation: Kirayste ayaa weydiinaya qufullo, qaylo-dhaan qiiq, iyo faahfaahinta xiriirka degdegga ah.
key_phrases: I want to check home safety.
Does the front door have a good lock?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: I want to check home safety.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rabaa inaan hubiyo badbaadada guriga.

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Of course. What do you want to check?

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Does the front door have a good lock?
dialogue.somali: Albaabka hore ma leeyahay quful fiican?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Yes, and here is the key.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Do the windows need keys?
dialogue.somali: Daaqaduhu furayaal ma u baahan yihiin?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: No, they lock from inside.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: Does the smoke alarm work?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: The smoke alarm works.

dialogue.speaker: Tenant
dialogue.english: What should I do in an emergency?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.english: Keep this emergency number.
